reviews.text: Great outcome!! These guys did great work, very reasonably priced and could not be happier. Great at communicating and did exactly as we discussed. Will be our go to for service in years ahead!!
reviews.author: Matthew Englert

reviews.text: I own a pool building and repair company in Montgomery County. I’ve used Mako restorations numerous times on our projects and they’ve always done an amazing job. Here’s a before and after of one of the worst calcium deposits I’ve ever seen. They took care of it no problem!
reviews.author: Troy Lane

reviews.text: Ryan was very responsive and knowledgeable. I reached out to him about serious calcium build up on our spa with glass tiles and what could be done. They did a great job bringing it back to like new condition, following 7 yrs of build up.
reviews.author: Toby Begnaud

reviews.text: Rhyne and team did a fantastic job. Explained everything before hand, stuck to the schedule, did a great job on the tile (I had forgotten what the tile looked like!), and even recommended products to keep it looking great going forward. Recommend them highly!
reviews.author: Curtis Lepley

reviews.text: Amazing company to work with. Rhyne explained to us the whole process of restoring the tiles to their beautiful shiny look, and that's exactly what he did his guy did. Great work ethic, he also gave us tips to prevent the calcium build up. Highly recommend Mako Pool Restauration!
reviews.author: Sylvie Morisset

reviews.text: Would give 10 stars if I could.   Rhyne and his team are the epitome of customer service and their work is exceptional.   We love working with them.
reviews.author: Amy Collier

reviews.text: Amazing company to work with. Honest, Reliable and trustworthy at Mako Pool Restorations. Another thing to add is great pricing for their services! I highly recommend using these guys for all things stone cleaning/Tile clean and sealing.
reviews.author: Jacob

reviews.text: Mako Restoration made my pool look like new again! That calcium is gone. They removed the calcium and then recommended some chemicals to use. It’s beautiful! Reasonably priced also.
reviews.author: Kristy Fitzgerald

data.summary: The reviews are highly detailed, specific, and varied, strongly suggesting authentic customer experiences. The lack of any negative reviews or complaints is notable but could be explained by a new, highly-focused company excelling in a niche service. The perfect score is a potential red flag statistically, but the content quality overrides this concern.
fake_signals: Perfect 5.0 rating with 54 reviews is statistically unusual
All reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific details (crew names: Ryan, Rhyne, team)
Mention of specific problems (calcium deposits, tile restoration)
Varied writing styles and perspectives (homeowner, industry professional)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only significant platform with reviews is Google, which shows a perfect 5.0 rating. No contradictory ratings from other platforms were found.
